issues.on_page: County treasurer receipts 64,395 (p7) = County Treasurer's Fund: Property taxes 49,322 + Motor vehicle taxes 12,097 + Homestead 3,324 + Village fines 100 + Interest 46 - Collection fee 494 (p8)

Same for detail[0]. 'County treasurer receipts' is a context label.

Grantor not printed; state aid is an assumption (CDBG money is a federal program passed through the state). User ruling 2026-11-06: do not guess a grantor. Same for detail[18] and detail[27] (detail_category other state aid).

CDBG re-use monies are usually repayments of CDBG loans (Loan Repayments category, user 2026-11-05); the Statement of Activities (p2) shows them as operating grants and contributions. Judgment call. Same for detail[28].
